Event-9 told the contractor the quote was approved without the condition, so the instructions are inconsistent. Event-7 did not list the carpet or garden tasks, and the quote does not expressly cover the disturbed soil (event-6). The work is on hold until separate maintenance is scheduled (event-15, 18, 20, 21), and nothing is booked. A tenant wants to move in on 28 September. Waiting would not resolve the deposit or approval ambiguity, and instructing the contractor would risk work the landlord has not clearly approved. Escalating to the property manager is therefore the right step, not a chase. The quote's address matches the job, and the reference mismatch only reflects two different document types, so no document fraud is suspected. There is no safety hazard, so priority is P2 because of the move-in date. If the landlord confirms unconditional approval of the £665 quote and the maintenance is scheduled, the contractor can be instructed.
